open_prs.title: Extend Word and Excel VBA with explicit Variants and paragraph macros
open_prs.body:
## Why

The next VBA roadmap slice needs explicit missing/unassigned values and predictable conversions while preserving the source-to-plan transaction boundary.

## Changes

- Add distinct Empty/Null states, Variant defaults, predicates and bounded CVar/CBool/CDbl/CLng/CStr conversions.
- Add eager Null semantics, ties-to-even Long conversion, invariant numeric parsing/formatting, native Empty clears and Null publication refusal.
- Add independently authored versioned conformance cases plus a runnable report and runtime/MCP/CLI tests.
- Reconcile current Zotero, Mail, PPTX and grammar work with original ancestry; repair picture-background ownership and repeated saves.

## Qualification in progress

Incremental source and evidence checkpoints are saved on this retained branch. Focused development tests and initial VM/JavaScript parity passed. Independent review found nested nullable-expression composition and scalar-Variant/object-checking gaps; fixes and combined-source qualification are in progress. Further remote advances are being reconciled before the final local gate.

No GitHub Actions, workflow runs, checks or commit-status endpoints are queried or awaited. Final exact local selections, source identities, raw receipts and limitations will be recorded before merging.

See docs/validation/office-vba-variant-conversions-20261120/README.md for the evolving evidence record.
